blocking_input: Matterport3D (MP3D) scene mesh in Habitat format
why: scripts/eval/configs/vln_r2r.yaml sets habitat.dataset.scenes_dir=data/scene_data/mp3d_ce and habitat.Env() loads the episode's scene_id from it. Without the mesh the official evaluator cannot construct the environment, so no episode can run.

scene_needed.note: Exactly ONE scene is required for the three frozen episodes, not the full 90-scene collection.

official_access_step.verbatim_requirement: To download the dataset, you must indicate that you agree to the terms of use by signing the Terms of Use agreement form, using your institutional email addresses, and sending it to: matterport3d@googlegroups.com
official_access_step.after_approval: The Matterport team grants download access to download_mp.py. habitat-sim DATASETS.md documents the Habitat-format download as: python download_mp.py --task habitat -o path/to/download/  (Python 2.7).
official_access_step.per_scene_selection_unverified: Whether download_mp.py exposes a per-scene flag was NOT verified from an authoritative page in this session; the script is only distributed after approval. If it does, restrict to 2azQ1b91cZZ.
official_access_step.reason_agent_cannot_complete: Requires a signed agreement from an institutional email address and an approval email exchange. No credential for this exists on either machine.
